label: r3c2
name: r2c3 32 minibatches
hypothesis: This is r2c3 with 32 minibatches (64 samples each) instead of 16. That doubles the gradient steps per update at the same sample count, since r is below 1 and the step budget is fixed. Optimisation, not data, seems to limit this net, so more and smaller steps should help. Refuted if dev drops clearly below r2c3's 0.88, to under about 0.5.
